Dear Team,

I would like to share my feedback regarding my recent visit to the Matunga Top 10 store, which left me very disappointed.

When I entered the store, I directly went to the Apple section to inquire about the iPhone 17 Pro. However, the staff member standing at the Apple section was busy on a personal call and did not respond to my query. Despite waiting, I did not receive any proper assistance.

At the same time, my friend was asking about an Oppo phone, but the staff members were forcefully pushing him to purchase a Samsung device instead, without properly explaining or respecting his requirement. This kind of behavior was very unprofessional.

I am a regular customer of Top 10 and have always trusted your brand, which is why this experience was very disappointing for me—especially the behavior of the staff at the Apple section.

I request you to please look into this matter seriously and ensure that your staff provides proper guidance, attention, and respectful service to customers.

Looking forward to a better experience in the future.

Thank you for your time and understanding.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal bagda
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am giving one star only because Google does not allow zero stars. This place does not deserve any rating.
I gave my laptop to this shop for repair. They kept it for one full day, and after that, they replied saying that my laptop battery was dead and needed replacement. There was no proper diagnosis explained, no clear testing shown—just a conclusion after a day.
Because this didn’t feel right, I took my laptop to the official service center of my laptop brand. There, they properly checked the laptop and clearly confirmed that the battery was completely fine and did NOT need replacement at all.
This experience seriously questions the honesty of this shop. It feels like customers are being misled into unnecessary repairs.
I strongly advise people not to rely on this shop for laptop repairs. Always take a second opinion from an official service center before trusting their diagnosis.

Pradeep, the guy who handles the mobile section here, is the reason I’ll never step into this shop again. And then, on the very day I was waiting for, he suddenly says there’s no stock! Seriously? If he had even a bit of professionalism, he would’ve told me earlier instead of making fake promises till the end.

Because of him, my special day got spoiled — and honestly, I’ve never seen someone handle customers so casually. The only good thing was that I got the same iPhone from the shop right next door – TOP 10, who actually know how to deal with customers properly.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammad Ali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with the Apple service process.

The service center took my adapter and asked me to come back after a week. Then after 3 days, I received a call saying the product was “not replaceable” and was asked to contact the retailer instead.

When I visited the retailer, they advised me to check with another service center. Surprisingly, within just 5 minutes, the second center checked the system and informed me that the product serial number did not match the adapter.

This clearly raises serious concerns. Either the retailer sold a faulty/fraud product, or the first service center failed to verify basic details before keeping my product and wasting my time.

Customers spend premium money trusting Apple’s ecosystem and authorized partners. Such unprofessional handling and lack of transparency damages that trust completely.

I request Apple to investigate this matter properly and ensure customers are not misled or harassed between retailers and service centers.

featured_reviews.name: Deven Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience with the salesperson, Muzaffar, at Vijay Sales. Before the purchase, he assured us that the AC would be delivered the very next day and installed within 48 hours. Based on these commitments, we went ahead with the purchase. However, when we followed up later, he completely denied making these promises and claimed he never said delivery would happen within 2 days. What disappointed us even more was that immediately after billing, he started insisting that we submit a positive Google review for him. When we politely told him that we would review the service after the AC was delivered and installed, his attitude changed completely. He responded by saying that his job was only to sell the product, clearly showing that customer satisfaction was no longer important once the payment was received. Also, customers should be careful not to fall into the trap of blindly following sales recommendations. Many suggestions provided by salespeople may be influenced by the commission they earn from selling specific brands rather than what is genuinely best for the customer This kind of behavior is misleading and unprofessional. Making commitments to secure a sale and then denying them later is unacceptable. Customers trust the information provided by sales representatives when making purchasing decisions. Unfortunately, our experience suggests that promises made before payment cannot be relied upon. I hope Vijay Sales management takes this feedback seriously and ensures that customers are not misled by false commitments simply to close a sale.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Deven Rathod, We are very sorry to hear about your experience and we offer you our sincerest apologies. Please share your concern and contact number on vcare@vijaysales.com so that we can assist  you personally on your raised concern- Team Vijay sales
